voyage_fuel_g_per_tnm_directional_meta.source: ANTAQ observed same-voyage corridors + EU MRV latest IMO intensity with robust vessel-class and ship-type fallbacks
voyage_fuel_g_per_tnm_directional_meta.segment_cargo_rule: minimum nonnegative onboard reconstruction: initial onboard equals max(0, -minimum cumulative net cargo), then each stop net is applied to the following leg
voyage_fuel_g_per_tnm_directional_meta.distance_resolution_rule: positive sea-matrix distance first; coordinate haversine fallback for distinct canonical ports when the matrix value is missing or nonpositive

fallback_outlier_policy.vessel_class: use artifact trimmed_mean_1pct; median when trimmed mean is unavailable
